steps.label: Confidentiality, Privacy

code:
Type I report
  tests: control DESIGN
  as of: one specified date
  answers: "if operated as described, would it work?"

Type II report
  tests: control OPERATING EFFECTIVENESS
  across: a 6-12 month review period
  answers: "did it actually operate that way, with evidence?"
caption: A Type II opinion is built on sampled evidence across months, not a single snapshot.

steps.label: Sampled termination tickets
steps.sub: checked against system logs for actual revocation timestamps

steps.label: Sampled change-management records
steps.sub: checked for a documented approval before each production deploy

steps.label: Noted exceptions are normal
steps.sub: a report with zero exceptions across every sample draws more scrutiny, not less

subtitle: A different kind of framework — a management system you certify, not a point-in-time report.
